title: flow panics on cyclic dependency graphs
description: pebbles flow panics (exit 101, rust-sugiyama cycle assertion) when required_for/scheduled_before edges form a cycle. Cycles are creatable because link does not validate them. Acceptance: compute_flow_layout returns a clear error on cyclic graphs; the CLI prints the error instead of panicking. Test: flow.rs unit test with an A->B->A edge list.
